A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DiffTOD study. Their full text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–J are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments on three dialogue datasets, human evaluations, a semantic-guidance analysis, and inference-cost measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Tables 1–3, Appendices H–J, and the associated figures and tables.

M1.justification: The diffusion planner and its word-level, semantic-level, and search-based guidance remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 makes the existing MCTS procedure more explicit through reward collection and backward-update bookkeeping; this improves its specification without establishing a different underlying method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CraigslistBargain negotiation with buyer and seller roles, TopDial recommendations, and PersonaChat conversations with ordered keyword targets. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain the same comparator membership, including ProCoT and EnPL, with PPDPP additionally evaluated for negotiation. The human comparison against PPDPP and inference-cost comparison against LLaMa-3-8B also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Dataset splits and counts in Table A1, evaluation metrics, the 10-turn limit, model configuration, and training/search settings are unchanged. Appendix H retains five annotators evaluating 50 sampled conversations; revised wording does not establish a changed protocol.

E4.justification: The turn-wise negotiation analysis, semantic-guidance-count experiment, inference-cost analysis, and conversation examples already appear in v1 and remain in v2. No new ablation, robustness test, or case study is introduced.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same averaged human-evaluation proportions and disagreement reporting. Neither adds experimental run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and A2–A3 have identical result entries, and Figures 5 and A2 retain the same plotted results. For example, DiffTOD's buyer/seller success rates remain 0.872/0.729, and its PersonaChat keyword coverage remains 0.845. The conversation examples are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The MDP definitions, trajectory and guidance equations, UCT formula, sell-to-list calculations, and Appendix J complexity analysis retain their mathematical content. Changes concern explanatory wording and equation formatting, without new assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: non-sequential diffusion-based dialogue planning, three flexible guidance mechanisms, and improved target achievement across three dialogue settings. Rewording does not substantively strengthen or narrow these claims.

C2.justification: Explanations involving global consistency, sparse rewards, long-range dependencies, candidate diversity, and inference cost retain their meaning. Section 8 preserves the same limitations concerning simulated environments, replanning, computational cost, and evaluation with real users.

D1.justification: v2 replaces the anonymous code/data link with a named GitHub repository. Appendix B clarifies action-keyword conditioning, and Algorithm 1 explicitly documents simulated reward collection, backward traversal, and visit-count increments. Existing hyperparameters, hardware information, and substantive prompt instructions remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain the same. Changes such as updating Chen et al. (2025) from a preprint to its journal publication and revising Ma et al.'s title are bibliographic updates, not additions to related work.

P1.justification: v2 makes distributed grammar and terminology corrections, streamlines explanations, and adds an acknowledgement section. Appendix G corrects 'user' to 'system' when describing the unchanged buyer/seller examples. The overall narrative and section organization remain stable.

P2.justification: Table A4 separates existing action keywords into a dedicated third column, and Algorithm 1 expands to display the additional bookkeeping explicitly. Captions, equation spacing, and text flow receive limited adjustments; the existing figures and result-table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves clarity and reproducibility documentation through more explicit MCTS pseudocode, clearer action-keyword presentation, corrected example-role descriptions, and language editing. These resolve limited ambiguities while preserving the scientific approach, empirical evidence, claims, and limitations.
